Scales the doppler shift of one channel, on top of the one of the listener. A radio that the player carries moves with them and should not shift at all. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
radio = EmitSound(music, camera)
ChannelDoppler radio, 0
```
@param channel  A channel handle from [EmitSound](EmitSound).
@param scale  `1` (what a channel starts with) gets all of the shift of [ListenerDoppler](ListenerDoppler), `0` none. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@gap A channel that is over is ignored. [GetChannelDoppler](GetChannelDoppler) tells the value.
